[[Hiroshi Kamiya]] ([[M22]]) }} '''Corey''' (Japanese: '''ソラオ''' ''Sorao'') is a supporting character who appeared in a number of [[Pokémon movie]]s. He is one of the [[Pokémon Trainer]]s who were invited by {{OBP|Mewtwo|M01}} to [[New Island]]. ==In the movies== [[File:Corey M22.png|thumb|left|250px|Corey in ''[[M22|Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution]]'']] ===Mewtwo Strikes Back and Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution=== Corey was one of the few {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who made it to [[New Island]]. He survived the storm and made the journey by flying on the back of his {{p|Pidgeot}}. Along with [[Neesha]], [[Fergus]], {{Ash}}, and {{ashfr}}, Corey witnessed the revelation that {{OBP|Mewtwo|M01}} was trying to destroy the world. Early in the night, Corey attempted have his {{p|Rhyhorn}} charge at Mewtwo, but the attack was quickly thwarted. Later, he challenged Mewtwo's cloned Venusaur using his own {{p|Venusaur}}, [[nickname]]d Bruteroot; however, Mewtwo's Venusaur easily defeated Bruteroot with a {{m|Vine Whip}}, sending it flying. Corey's Pokémon tried to defend themselves against the [[Poké Ball|Mewtwo Balls]] but were soon {{pkmn2|caught}} and later cloned. Corey watched from the sidelines as the original and cloned Pokémon fought endlessly while Mewtwo fought {{OBP|Mew|M01}}. Ash eventually intervened and was caught in the crossfire, leading Mewtwo to have a revelation and end the challenge. As a result, Mewtwo wiped everyone's memories, including those of Corey, regarding the events on New Island, and then returned them and their Pokémon to [[Old Shore Wharf]]. Later, Corey joined [[Officer Jenny]] and the other Trainers on the pier to watch the storm miraculously clear up. ====Character==== Corey is a confident individual, and he proudly boasted about the strengths of his Pokémon when {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} first arrived at the [[New Island]] fortress. He takes charge of a situation and is prepared to fight back. However, Corey can be impulsive, as shown when he had his {{p|Rhyhorn}} charge at {{OBP|Mewtwo|M01}}, and when he was the first to challenge the Genetic Pokémon's cloned Pokémon. ====Pokémon==== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Corey's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Corey |pkmn=Pidgeot |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Corey Pidgeot.png |img2=Corey Pidgeot M22.png |cap=Corey's Pidgeot in Mewtwo Strikes Back |cap2=Corey's Pidgeot in Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution |epnum=M01 |epname=Mewtwo Strikes Back |desc={{p|Pidgeot}} was Corey's means of getting to [[New Island]], as the ferries from [[Old Shore Wharf]] was canceled by {{OBP|Mewtwo|M01}}'s storm. Jon Samaniego ([[M22]])}} ===''I Choose You!''=== [[File:Corey M20.png|thumb|250px|Corey in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'']] Corey made a cameo appearance in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', which is set in a continuity separate from {{aniseries|PTS}}. He battled [[Neesha]] in the final round of a [[Pokémon League Conference]], in the same vein as the two Trainers seen in the opening of [[EP001|the debut episode]] of the main series. The outcome of the battle was left unknown. The battle was watched on TV by {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|M20|Ash}}, who thoroughly enjoyed watching the match. {{-}} ====Pokémon==== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of Corey's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]''. {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Corey |pkmn=Gengar |type1=Ghost |type2=Poison |img=Corey Gengar.png |epnum=M20 |epname=I Choose You! |vaen=Marc Thompson |desc=In the midst of Corey's battle against [[Neesha]], {{p|Gengar}} went up against Neesha's {{p|Blastoise}}. It managed to dodge Blastoise's attacks, until it was frozen by Blastoise's {{m|Ice Beam}}. This caused Corey to recall Gengar. Gengar's only known move is {{m|Night Shade}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Corey |pkmn=Venusaur |gender=male |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Corey Venusaur.png |epnum=M20 |epname=I Choose You! |vajp= |vaen=Justin Anselmi |desc={{p|Venusaur}} was used in Corey's battle against [[Neesha]] in the final round of a [[Pokémon League]]. After Corey recalled his Gengar during the battle against Neesha's {{p|Blastoise}}, he sent out Venusaur. They exchanged attacks, both managing to hold on. The outcome of the battle is unknown. It is unknown if he is nicknamed Bruteroot in this movie's continuity as well. Venusaur's known moves are {{m|Razor Leaf}}, {{m|Tackle}}, and {{m|Solar Beam}}.}} Corey has at least four other Pokémon, as indicated by the scoreboard. ==In the manga== [[File:Corey M22 manga.png|thumb|180px|Corey in the Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution manga]] ===Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution=== Corey appeared in ''{{ma|Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution}}'', serving the same role as in the film. ====Pokémon==== {| style="float:left; width: 96px" |- | {{ActivePoké|Corey|Venusaur|Corey Pokémon M22 manga.png|grass|poison|size=100px|link=no}} ♂ | {{ActivePoké|Corey|Sandslash|Corey Pokémon M22 manga.png|ground|size=100px|link=no}} | {{ActivePoké|Corey|Hitmonlee|Corey Pokémon M22 manga.png|fighting|size=100px|link=no}} |- | {{ActivePoké|Corey|Scyther|Corey Pokémon M22 manga.png|bug|flying|size=100px|link=no}} | {{ActivePoké|Corey|Pidgeot|Corey Pokémon M22 manga.png|normal|flying|size=100px|link=no}} | {{ActivePoké|Corey|Rhyhorn|Corey Pokémon M22 manga.png|rock|ground|size=100px|link=no}} |} {{-}} ==Trivia== * In the {{pmin|Latin America}}n dub of the movie, Corey was referred to as [[Gary Oak]].
